t: A tiny, cheap Linux computer with Wi-Fi and a wired network port.
steps: Buy the board from the Orange Pi official links on Amazon or the Orange Pi Xunlong Store on AliExpress. Pick the 1, 1.5, 2 or 4 GB version.
Get a 5 volt 3 amp USB-C power supply, a microSD card and a micro HDMI adapter.
Download Debian or Ubuntu from the official Orange Pi download page. Armbian images are another choice.
Write the image to the microSD card with an image writing app.
Insert the card and connect power and a network cable or a screen.
Follow the setup steps in the Orange Pi Zero 3 user manual.
Try the 26-pin header examples in the manual to blink an LED.
